title: contacts
description: A collection of contacts associated with a primary entity.

relation.description: The nature of the contact's relationship to the primary entity.

level.description: Relative priority of the contact. Multiple contacts may share the same level. Omit if unspecified.

methods.description: Known means of reaching the contact.

type.description: General classification of the contact method.

value.description: Information needed to reach the contact through this method, expressed as plain text without prescribed formatting.
examples: The benches beside the fountain in the public park
The wooden noticeboard outside the community hall

level.description: Relative preference for this contact method. Multiple methods may share the same level. Omit if unspecified.

notes.description: Additional context, instructions, or limitations concerning this contact method.
examples: Usually there between 2:00 and 5:00 PM on Fridays, weather permitting.
Leave a handwritten message on the noticeboard.
Knock twice on the blue door.

notes.description: Additional information or context concerning the contact.
